meta.title: Keyline One — Classic keypad. Touchscreen smartphone.
meta.description: Keyline One is a compact hybrid phone: a real physical keypad combined with a colour touchscreen. Explore it in 3D and try the interactive demo.

hero.subtitle: A compact phone that pairs a tactile numeric keypad with a colour touchscreen — the simplicity you remember, the apps you rely on.

presentation.title: Classic control. A different smartphone experience.
presentation.intro: Most phones force a choice: a touchscreen smartphone or a simple button phone. Keyline One combines both in one compact body. Type, dial and navigate with real keys — and tap the screen whenever touch is faster.

front.title: Two ways to control. One device.
front.text: A colour touchscreen in the upper half, a full physical keypad in the lower half. Use whichever feels natural at the moment.

display.title: A screen that responds to touch.
display.text: Tap app icons, scroll and swipe like on any smartphone — on a display sized to keep the phone compact.

keypad.title: Keys you can feel.
keypad.text: Individual tactile buttons for numbers, calls and navigation, plus a central circular control. Dial without looking.

back.title: Clean back. Rear camera.
back.text: A minimal graphite back with a rear camera module in the corner.

scale.title: Made to disappear into a pocket.
scale.text: Narrow and compact — shown here next to a standard bank card (85.6 × 54 mm) for scale.
scale.note: Approximate scale based on reference photos. Exact dimensions will be published once verified.

items.q: Is this a smartphone or a traditional button phone?
items.a: Both. Keyline One has a colour touchscreen in the upper half and a full physical keypad in the lower half. You can navigate with touch, with the keys, or with both.

The device is designed for app use, and the reference units run apps. Which app store and operating system version ship with the final product is still being confirmed with the manufacturer. We will publish it here before sales open.
This is being verified on production units. We will only confirm WhatsApp support once we have tested it ourselves.
This is being verified on production units. We will only confirm Telegram support once we have tested it ourselves.
4G support and the exact network bands are being confirmed with the manufacturer. Please check back before ordering.

sections.p: The controller of your personal data is {entity}, {address}. Contact: {email}.

When you submit a test order we collect your name, email address, country, optional phone number, selected quantity, selected language and the time of submission. We also process your IP address briefly to protect the form against abuse (rate limiting) and to choose a suitable website language.
To respond to your request and to inform you about the product's availability (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR — steps prior to a contract) and to protect our website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR — legitimate interest).
Test order requests are stored for {days} days and then deleted, unless you ask us to delete them earlier.
Your request is delivered by email through our email service provider, acting as a processor. [List processors, e.g. hosting and email providers, and any transfers outside the EU.]
We use only strictly necessary storage: a cookie and local storage entry that remember your language. We do not use analytics or advertising cookies.

You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and port your data, and to object to processing. You may also lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority (in Lithuania: State Data Protection Inspectorate; in Germany: the data protection authority of your federal state).
This website is currently used to test interest in the product. Submitting a test order does not create a purchase contract, no payment is taken and no product is shipped.
Prices shown are indicative and include VAT where applicable. Final prices will be confirmed before sales open.
Product images include renders of a provisional 3D model. Specifications marked “To be confirmed” are not yet verified.
No orders are shipped during the test phase. Shipping destinations, carriers, times and costs will be published before sales open.
Consumers in the EU have the right to withdraw from a distance contract within 14 days without giving a reason. Full withdrawal instructions and a model withdrawal form will be added here.
The statutory legal guarantee applies. Any additional manufacturer warranty will be described here.
